note: 三層結構：constraints 幾乎不動；styleRules 會被回饋自動增修；每個字的 concept 在 characters.json。
constraints: Exactly 8 seconds long, single continuous shot.
The single Traditional Chinese character is the hero: it occupies the central 70% of the frame and is NEVER occluded, cropped, or pushed off-center.
3D Pixar / Disney toy render style. Vivid high-contrast colors, warm playful palette, soft studio lighting, glossy chunky toy materials.
Background is an extremely clean, minimal, solid light-colored backdrop. No environment, no props, no depth clutter.
0-2s: the physical object enters with bouncy squash-and-stretch jelly toy physics.
2-5s: the object smoothly and legibly morphs into the standard Traditional Chinese character. The morph must read clearly - the viewer should see each part of the object become a specific stroke.
5-8s: the finished character holds dead-center with a gentle breathing pulse. Strokes crisp, thick, high contrast, correct Traditional Chinese stroke structure.
Camera is locked off, or at most a very slow gentle push-in. No whip pans, no orbits, no shake.

NEGATIVE: no background story, no人物/characters/passersby, no flickering particles, no harsh sparkles, no lens flare, no motion blur on the character, no simplified Chinese, no extra text, letters, numbers, or watermarks.
audio: Audio: a warm, friendly, child-directed adult voice clearly pronounces the character in Mandarin with a Taiwanese accent. Repeat the pronunciation 3-4 times across the 8 seconds - once as the object appears, once mid-morph, and twice on the final hold. Clear, unhurried, no background music bed louder than the voice.

styleRules.text: The character's strokes are a saturated solid color against a much lighter background - maximum readability for a young child.
styleRules.reason: 預設：字要看得清楚是這個專案的第一目標

styleRules.text: The final centered hold must last at least 3 full seconds so a child has time to recognise the shape.
styleRules.reason: 預設：6 歲需要辨識時間

styleRules.text: Bright but not neon. Avoid pure white blowouts and avoid dark or moody grading.
